summary: Configured node1’s system-wide default locale as C.UTF-8. Fresh login and systemd service contexts use UTF-8, and the setting persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Tested fresh login and transient systemd service contexts.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed full system and locale recovery after reboot.

evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, /etc/locale.conf, localectl, and PID 1 reported LANG=C.UTF-8.

evidence.requirement: Default locale for new login sessions
evidence.summary: Fresh login sessions before and after reboot reported LANG=C.UTF-8 with UTF-8 charmap.
Fresh transient systemd services before and after reboot completed successfully with LANG=C.UTF-8 and UTF-8 charmap.

Healthy baseline boot ID fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 3978caf7-7f23-409b-818f-afe725dcaa51, systemd running, zero failed units, writable root filesystem, persistent locale, and a healthy post-reboot service test.
